title: yodel drift <env> --json
description: Version 1. The declared objects changed out of band (changed) or gone (missing), and those chant could not read (unobserved: not drift, and not clean). Objects the project does not declare are never reported. Within a version, fields are only added; a reader ignores fields it does not know.

changed.description: chant's deep drift for each changed object: its name, kind and the properties that differ, declared against live. chant owns this object: fields beyond the required ones may appear.

unobserved.description: Declared objects chant could not read, each with its name and why.

lockWait.description: Postgres: a read gave up at the lock timeout, and what it waited on.

columns.description: Each changed table's declared column names, by position.

against.description: What the server was compared with: src, the project's declarations; or history, the schema the newest applied migration records (migration null when none is applied yet).

drifted.description: A declared object changed or is gone: the command exits 2.

fingerprint.description: A hash of the environment and what drifted: the same for the same drift, run after run.

issue.description: --issue: what yodel did with the environment's tracking issue, and the issue when there is one.

issueError.description: --issue: the tracking issue could not be written, and why.
